name: A Trade of Immersion Server
author: yucktheslime
description: CHIM-style AI server for the A Trade of Immersion Minecraft mod (MCA Reborn companions and villagers): dialogue, memory, 13 allowlisted actions, game events, NPC bios and optional voice. Based on the Kagrenac template.

game.name: Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge, MCA Reborn)
game.version: Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.267, MCA Reborn 7.7.36, Architectury API 13.0.8
game.loader: A NeoForge 1.21.1 modpack with MCA Reborn and Architectury API (for example a CurseForge profile). Select the profile's folder (CurseForge: right-click the profile > Open Folder); start it once first so options.txt exists.
game.enable_in_game: Close Minecraft first. Remove any older a-trade-of-immersion jar from the mods folder, then start the modpack and run /npc ai status in game.

features: Talk to your companions and MCA villagers in normal chat; they answer in character
Companions follow, fight, ride, equip, eat, give, pick up and inspect items on request
Deaths, fights, gifts and MCA family changes are remembered and reacted to
Edit NPC bios, read conversations and pick the AI model on the dashboard
Optional voice (PocketTTS) played from the NPC's position
Optional: a hosted Minecraft server can use the AI on your PC through a tunnel

testing.summary: Author-tested on a NeoForge 1.21.1 dedicated server and client with MCA Reborn: chat turns, actions, death and fight events, offline queue and recovery, server-streamed voice. Uses a mock LLM in automated checks; real model quality depends on your provider.
